question: Food Aerosols Spain S.L. company profile
markdown:
Food Aerosols Spain S.L. is
a European contract manufacturer and private label specialist focused on packaging food products into aerosol sprays
. The company produces custom and standard spray formats—such as cooking oils, olive oil sprays, and baking releases—for both retail consumer brands and the food service industry.
